'''Sector 7''' was a location in [[Ardan resistance|Rebel]] territory that [[Jerrod Lourdas]] neglected to scan so he could scan [[Sector 17 (Arda I)|Sector 17]]. When Jerrod returned to [[Arda Base]], [[Harl Bess]] and [[Var Narek]] scolded him, telling him that if he let his guard down, the base could be overrun with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. Jerrod was dismissive of this though, and made a joke about the whole ordeal.
